claims.text: jiant supports over 50 NLU tasks, including all GLUE and SuperGLUE benchmark tasks.
jiant contains a task bank of over 50 tasks, including individual tasks like CommonsenseQA and SocialIQA.
jiant is designed to maintain and grow a collection of tasks useful for NLU research.
